title: PHYSICS FORM 1
text:
FORM ONE EXAM
 PHYSICS
 Answer all questions in the spaces provided.
 1. Define Physics. (1mk)
 2. Explain the relationship between physics and Mathematics. (1mk)
 3. State three basic rules in a laboratory relating to electricity. (3mks)
 4. Briefly explain the first aid for the following;-
 a) Acid or base burns. (1 mk)
 b) Poison in the eye. (1mk)
 5. Fill the following table. (4mks)
 Basic physical SI unit Symbol of units
 quantity
 Length
 Second.
 Kelvin.
 6. Define the following terms and state their SI units.
 a) Area - (2mks)
 b) Mass - (2mks)
 c) Density - (2mks)
 7. Differentiate between a basic quantity and a derived quantity. (2mks)
 8. (a) A length 550cm of thin thread wraps around a cylinder exactly 25 times.
 Calculate the circumference and the radius of the cylinder (Take 𝜋 = 22⁄7)
 (3mks)
 (b) If a ream of 500 papers weighs 2.5kg find the mass of single sheet in;
 i. Kg. (2mks)
 ii. g (1mk)
 9. State two career opportunities when one studies Physics. (2mks)
 10. Outline the procedure for using a metre rule when measuring the length
 of a book (3mks)
